Purpose: removable repository-local descriptor fsync dispatch for bazil FUSE.

Source: bazil.org/fuse v0.0.0-20230120002735-62a210ff1fd5.
UPSTREAM.gclone.json preserves the original source hashes. LICENSE and
copyright notices remain intact. The only modified upstream file is fs/serve.go.

LOCAL CHANGE
HandleFsyncer resolves the FsyncRequest handle before invoking application code.
It releases the server registry lock before the callback, preserves NodeFsyncer
as a fallback, and reports invalid handles and callback errors. gclone's native
mount uses the accepted descriptor's Sync, so unrelated closes do not delay it.

The full-cache data policy is implemented in gclone cmd/mountlib and VFS.
It uses the existing ExplicitInvalidateData API; no automatic-invalidation
option or default capability change is added to this library.

The root go.mod replacement points to this directory. No remote fork, build
preparation step, or GitHub Actions workflow change is required.

REMOVAL
When upstream provides equivalent descriptor fsync dispatch, update native
mount to that API, remove the local replace and this directory, and run the
handle dispatch/error tests, Linux cache/lifecycle tests and normal/cmount
cross-platform builds. Preserve the independent VFS WAL, unlink and rename fixes.
